title: AttributionRecord
description: What probably caused an outcome, stated honestly. Implemented by advantage_foundry/attribution.py. The default view renders bands; shares live only in the audit payload.

share.description: Audit-only. Never rendered in the default view — no '27.43%'.

baseline.description: Matched comparison, not last quarter's number.

confounders.description: Named, not hidden. Each one costs a confidence level.

what_did_not_matter.description: Rendered only when a component was actually varied and measured. Never filled with a plausible guess.

$comment: Contribution shares are not required to sum to 1. Whatever the known actors do not explain is published as an unexplained remainder; distributing 100% of every outcome is the fake-causality failure mode this schema exists to prevent.
